summary: The MaintHeader file is part of a web application, implementing functionality for maintaining header records. It involves ASP.NET web forms with various controls for managing records including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying data in a grid view.
purpose: The main purpose of the MaintHeader functionality is to allow users to maintain records related to headings via a web interface. This includes operations like adding new entries, editing existing ones, and removing records through a series of UI controls and server-side logic.

workflows.name: Maintaining Headers
steps: User selects a category from dropdown list.
User adds a new record using the 'Add' command.
User edits an existing record by selecting and using the 'Edit' command.
User deletes a record using the 'Delete' command.
Data is refreshed to show the latest records.

business_rules: The SortOrder field must be a number and is mandatory.
Records are manipulated via a web interface using various button commands.
conditions: If a record is new (CodeID == 0), then it is added.
If a record already exists (CodeID != 0), then it is updated.
system_behavior: The page loads and initializes by setting up user sessions and focusing on category dropdown.
On postbacks, the page refreshes data and updates UI panels accordingly.
Data binding is used to display records in grid and detail views, with AJAX support for asynchronous updates.
dependencies: Grid and Headings classes for managing UI and data operations.
exceptions: Errors in data operations are captured and displayed in error panels.
